title: My First Game
author: Tuton012
selftext:
Hi guys, here’s my game called Miner Clicker. It started as my 12-year-old son’s idea, and he’s been helping me build it. Of course we’ve had some help from AI since I’m new to making games, but I’m really proud of the path my son is taking.

All the ideas came from him. The game still has a few bugs here and there, but it already has multiplayer and, believe it or not, it’s running on a Raspberry Pi.

https://minerclicker.pages.dev/

I was wondering if anyone has ideas on what features we could add to make the game more fun?

So far added live events, Boss summon event with lobby and added Mine raids

Thank you 🙏

replies.author: Tuton012
replies.body:
Thank you for your feedback 🙏

Yes, it’s still very basic right now, just pure HTML and JavaScript.

The game is still in early development. So far, it includes special gems that can be used to craft armor, swords, helmets, boots, and gloves. You can also hire fighters with different skills, equip them with gear, and raid other players’ mines.

I’ve added a progression system with ranks and XP levels for fighters. You can craft rare weapons (Rare, Legendary, and Mythic), with about a 1% chance depending on the combination of ores and gems used at the crafting table. These items can also be sold on the market.

This week, I added live events and boss battles. Bosses will spawn at random times, and players can join a lobby to fight together for higher payouts and possible boss loot.

Over the next few days, I’ll be working on improving the layout and making it more mobile-friendly.

Thanks again, I really appreciate you taking the time to check it out 😊
